main

FastAPI application for Dispatch — voice and typed command orchestration.

Routes are organized into sections:

  • /api/settings — user preferences, provider, base path, OTP, agent tokens
  • /api/device — device pairing and project linking for local agents
  • /api/voice — Twilio voice webhooks, audio transcription
  • /api/telegram — Telegram bot webhook
  • /api/dashboard — user projects and call history
  • /api/tasks — task CRUD and agent dispatch
  • /api/agent — agent execution status
  • /api/terminal — terminal session and command management
  • /api/unified — unified command timeline and reply handling

  45class AccessLogThrottleFilter(logging.Filter):
  46    """
  47    Keep useful access logs while suppressing repetitive high-frequency noise.
  48    - Drops OPTIONS requests.
  49    - Throttles repeated 200 logs for polling endpoints.
  50    """
  51
  52    def __init__(self, window_s: float = 10.0):
  53        super().__init__()
  54        self.window_s = window_s
  55        self._last_seen: dict[str, float] = {}
  56        self._lock = threading.Lock()
  57        self.noisy_paths = (
  58            "/api/device/claim-next",
  59            "/api/device/heartbeat",
  60            "/api/agent/local/claim-next",
  61            "/api/agent/local/heartbeat",
  62            "/api/agent/executions/",
  63            "/api/terminal/commands/",
  64            "/api/terminal/sessions/",
  65            "/api/unified/timeline",
  66            "/api/terminal/commands/",      # list + logs
  67            "/api/terminal/sessions/",      # polling
  68            "/api/call-sessions/",          # if it’s chatty
  69        )
  70
  71    def filter(self, record: logging.LogRecord) -> bool:
  72        msg = record.getMessage()
  73        if "OPTIONS " in msg:
  74            return False
  75        # If it's one of the noisy endpoints and succeeded, drop it completely
  76        if any(p in msg for p in self.noisy_paths) and '" 200 OK' in msg:
  77            return False
  78
  79        # Otherwise, keep the log
  80        return True
  81        # is_noisy = any(p in msg for p in self.noisy_paths)
  82        # is_ok = '" 200 OK' in msg
  83        # if not (is_noisy and is_ok):
  84        #     return True
  85
  86        # key = msg.split("HTTP/1.1")[0] if "HTTP/1.1" in msg else msg
  87        # now = time.time()
  88        # with self._lock: 
  89        #     last = self._last_seen.get(key, 0.0)
  90        #     if now - last < self.window_s:
  91        #         return False
  92        #     self._last_seen[key] = now
  93        # return True
  94
  95
  96logging.basicConfig(
  97    level=getattr(logging, LOG_LEVEL, logging.INFO),
  98    format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s [%(name)s] %(message)s",
  99)

 152@app.middleware("http")
 153async def request_trace_middleware(request, call_next):
 154    request_id = request.headers.get("x-request-id") or str(uuid.uuid4())[:8]
 155    request.state.request_id = request_id
 156    start = time.perf_counter()
 157    try:
 158        response = await call_next(request)
 159    except Exception:
 160        logger.exception("request_id=%s uncaught error path=%s", request_id, request.url.path)
 161        raise
 162
 163    elapsed_ms = int((time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000)
 164    # Structured app logs for debugging; keep polling/noisy paths at debug level.
 165    is_noisy = (
 166        request.url.path.startswith("/api/device/claim-next")
 167        or request.url.path.startswith("/api/device/heartbeat")
 168        or request.url.path.startswith("/api/device/my-projects")
 169        or request.url.path.startswith("/api/device/commands/")
 170        or request.url.path.startswith("/api/device/cursor-context")
 171        or request.url.path.startswith("/api/agent/local/claim-next")
 172        or request.url.path.startswith("/api/agent/local/heartbeat")
 173        or request.url.path.startswith("/api/agent/executions/")
 174        or request.url.path.startswith("/api/terminal/commands/")
 175        or request.url.path.startswith("/api/unified/timeline")
 176    )
 177    # Avoid spamming INFO for 401 polling failures; still keep errors visible.
 178    if is_noisy:
 179        level = logging.DEBUG if response.status_code < 500 else logging.WARNING
 180    else:
 181        level = logging.INFO
 182    logger.log(
 183        level,
 184        "request_id=%s method=%s path=%s status=%s elapsed_ms=%s",
 185        request_id,
 186        request.method,
 187        request.url.path,
 188        response.status_code,
 189        elapsed_ms,
 190    )
 191    response.headers["x-request-id"] = request_id
 192    return response

 194# --- 3. SECURITY ---
 195def get_current_user(authorization: Annotated[Union[str, None], Header()] = None):
 196    """
 197    Validates the Supabase JWT. Returns the Supabase User object.
 198    In DEVELOPMENT_MODE: if a JWT is provided, use it; otherwise fall back to a mock user.
 199    """
 200    # If a real token is present, always honor it (even in dev mode)
 201    has_auth = bool(authorization)
 202
 203    if has_auth:
 204        # If client sent a JWT, we must be able to validate it. Otherwise fail loudly.
 205        if not SUPABASE_URL or not SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY:
 206            raise HTTPException(
 207                status_code=500,
 208                detail="Supabase server env not configured (SUPABASE_URL/SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY). Check server/.env loading.",
 209            )
 210
 211        try:
 212            if " " in authorization:
 213                token = authorization.split(" ")[1]
 214            else:
 215                token = authorization
 216            supabase: Client = create_client(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY)
 217            user_response = supabase.auth.get_user(token)
 218            u = user_response.user
 219            return u
 220        except Exception as e:
 221            logger.warning("supabase auth failed err=%r", e)
 222            raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid or Expired Token")
 223
 224    # No token (or token invalid in dev): allow mock user only in dev mode
 225    if DEVELOPMENT_MODE:
 226        class MockUser:
 227            id = os.environ.get("DEV_USER_ID", "test-user-123")
 228            email = os.environ.get("DEV_USER_EMAIL", "test@example.com")
 229            phone = os.environ.get("DEV_USER_PHONE", None)
 230        return MockUser()
 231
 232    raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Missing Authorization Header")

 235def get_current_agent_user_id(
 236    x_agent_token: Annotated[Union[str, None], Header(alias="X-Agent-Token")] = None,
 237) -> str:
 238    """
 239    Auth for local agents (no Supabase JWT required).

 388def _require_project_owner(user_id: str, project_id: str) -> dict:
 389    """Fetch a project and assert the caller owns it. Raises 404/403 otherwise."""
 390    project = models.get_project_by_id(project_id)
 391    if not project:
 392        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Project not found")
 393    if project.get("user_id") != user_id:
 394        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden")
 395    return project

 432def _require_device_owner(user_id: str, device_id: str) -> dict:
 433    """Fetch a device and assert it belongs to the authenticated user. Raises 404 otherwise."""
 434    devices = models.list_devices_for_user(user_id)
 435    dev = next((d for d in devices if d.get("id") == device_id), None)
 436    if not dev:
 437        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Device not found")
 438    return dev

 441def _is_affirmation_intent(t: str) -> bool:
 442    """Recognize spoken/typed approvals for the voice approval gate."""
 443    if not t:
 444        return False
 445    t = re.sub(r"[^\w\s]", " ", t).strip().lower()
 446    t = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", t)
 447    if not t:
 448        return False
 449    exact = frozenset({
 450        "yes", "y", "yep", "yeah", "yup", "ok", "okay", "sure",
 451        "approve", "approved", "execute", "run it", "do it", "go ahead",
 452        "looks good", "sounds good", "confirmed", "ship it",
 453        "that's fine", "that is fine",
 454    })
 455    if t in exact:
 456        return True
 457    if len(t) <= 80:
 458        for phrase in (
 459            "go ahead", "run it", "do it", "approve it", "approve this",
 460            "execute it", "execute", "looks good", "sounds good",
 461            "yes please", "ok run", "run that",
 462        ):
 463            if phrase in t:
 464                return True
 465    return False
 466

 468def _load_state_context(raw: dict | None) -> dict:
 469    """Extract and deserialize the context_json field from a conversation state row.
 470
 471    Returns an empty dict if the row is missing or context_json is not valid JSON.
 472    """
 473    if not raw:
 474        return {}
 475    ctx = raw.get("context_json")
 476    if not ctx:
 477        return {}
 478    if isinstance(ctx, dict):
 479        return ctx
 480    if isinstance(ctx, str):
 481        try:
 482            parsed = json.loads(ctx)
 483            return parsed if isinstance(parsed, dict) else {}
 484        except Exception:
 485            return {}
 486    return {}
 487

 489def _classify_reply(text: str) -> str:
 490    """Classify a free-text reply into one of: 'approve', 'reject', 'edit', 'question', 'empty', or 'command'.
 491
 492    Used by the voice/Telegram approval flow to decide how to handle a user's response
 493    to a pending command without requiring exact keyword matches.
 494    """
 495    t = (text or "").strip().lower()
 496    if not t:
 497        return "empty"
 498    if _is_affirmation_intent(t):
 499        return "approve"
 500    normalized = re.sub(r"[^\w\s]", " ", t).strip().lower()
 501    normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", normalized)
 502    if normalized in {"no", "n", "reject", "cancel", "don t run", "do not run", "stop", "abort"}:
 503        return "reject"
 504    if normalized.startswith("edit ") or normalized.startswith("change ") or normalized.startswith("instead "):
 505        return "edit"
 506    if t.endswith("?") or normalized.startswith("what ") or normalized.startswith("why ") or normalized.startswith("how "):
 507        return "question"
 508    return "unknown"

 511async def _background_security_scan(command_id: str, user_prompt: str, normalized_command: str) -> None:
 512    """Runs after response; persists risk_level / risk_reason in the local command sidecar."""
 513    from services.security_analyzer import analyze_command_security_with_fallback
 514
 515    try:
 516        result = await analyze_command_security_with_fallback(
 517            user_prompt=user_prompt,
 518            normalized_command=normalized_command,
 519        )
 520        risk_level = result["risk_level"]
 521        risk_reason = result["risk_reason"]
 522        plain_summary = result.get("plain_summary")
 523        models.update_command_risk_assessment(
 524            command_id=command_id,
 525            risk_level=risk_level,
 526            risk_reason=risk_reason,
 527            plain_summary=plain_summary,
 528        )
 529        # Preserve old "safe command runs" behavior: auto-queue only when still awaiting approval.
 530        if (risk_level or "").strip().upper() == "SAFE":
 531            cmd = models.get_terminal_command(command_id)
 532            if cmd and cmd.get("status") == "pending_approval":
 533                updated = models.update_terminal_command_for_approval(command_id=command_id, status="queued")
 534                session = models.get_terminal_session(cmd["session_id"]) if cmd.get("session_id") else None
 535                project_id = session.get("project_id") if session else None
 536                models.add_conversation_turn(
 537                    user_id=cmd.get("user_id"),
 538                    project_id=project_id,
 539                    session_id=cmd.get("session_id"),
 540                    command_id=command_id,
 541                    role="assistant",
 542                    turn_type="approval_result",
 543                    content="Security scan marked this command safe. Running now.",
 544                )
 545                models.upsert_conversation_state(
 546                    user_id=cmd.get("user_id"),
 547                    project_id=project_id,
 548                    state="idle",
 549                    active_command_id=None,
 550                    context_json={},
 551                )
 552                logger.info("auto-approved safe command command_id=%s status=%s", command_id, (updated or {}).get("status"))
 553    except Exception:
 554        logger.exception("security scan failed command_id=%s", command_id)
 555        try:
 556            models.update_command_risk_assessment(
 557                command_id=command_id,
 558                risk_level="WARNING",
 559                risk_reason="Security scan failed; review manually before approving.",
 560            )
 561        except Exception:
 562            pass

 639import re as _re

 644@app.post("/api/phone/send-otp")
 645@limiter.limit("5/minute")
 646async def send_otp(request: Request, body: SendOtpRequest, user: dict = Depends(get_current_user)):
 647    if not _E164_RE.match(body.phone_number):
 648        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Phone number must be in E.164 format (e.g. +12125551234)")
 649    success = phone_verification.send_verification(body.phone_number)
 650    if not success:
 651        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail="Failed to send verification code")
 652    return {"success": True}

 657    if not _E164_RE.match(request.phone_number):
 658        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Phone number must be in E.164 format (e.g. +12125551234)")
 659    approved = phone_verification.check_verification(request.phone_number, request.code)
 660    if not approved:
 661        return {"success": False, "error": "Invalid or expired verification code"}
 662    try:

 785        local_path=local_path,
 786    )
 787    return {"success": True, "project": project, "link": link}

 790# --- 5. THE CORE ENDPOINT (EAR + BRAIN + HANDS) ---
 791@app.post("/transcribe")
 792@limiter.limit("10/minute")
 793async def transcribe_audio(
 794    request: Request,
 795    file: UploadFile = File(...),
 796    user: dict = Depends(get_current_user),
 797    background_tasks: BackgroundTasks = None,
 798):
 799    """
 800    1. Transcribes Audio (Whisper)
 801    2. Fetches Context (SQLite)
 802    3. Determines Intent (Bedrock)
 803    4. Executes Action (SQLite)
 804    5. Dispatches to Agent Pipeline (Background)
 805    """
 806    try:
 807        logger.info("transcribe start user_id=%s filename=%s", getattr(user, "id", None), file.filename)
 808
 809        # Ensure a corresponding users row exists (id comes from Supabase)
 810        models.upsert_user(
 811            user_id=user.id,
 812            email=getattr(user, "email", None) or f"{user.id}@local",
 813            phone_number=getattr(user, "phone", None),
 814        )
 815
 816        # A. Transcribe via Groq Whisper API
 817        logger.debug("transcribe step=a")
 818        import tempfile as _tempfile
 819        with _tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=f"_{file.filename}", delete=True) as tmp:
 820            shutil.copyfileobj(file.file, tmp)
 821            tmp.flush()
 822            transcript_text = await transcribe_file(tmp.name)
 823        logger.debug("transcribe text_len=%s", len(transcript_text))
 824        
 825        # B. Context
 826        logger.debug("transcribe step=b")
 827        user_projects = models.get_user_projects(user.id)
 828        logger.debug("transcribe projects_count=%s", len(user_projects))
 829        # C. Parse Intent
 830        logger.debug("transcribe step=c")
 831        intent_data = await parse_intent(transcript_text, user_projects) or {"intent": "unknown"}
 832        logger.debug("transcribe intent=%s", intent_data.get("intent"))
 833        
 834        # Normalize for storage
 835        intent_type = intent_data.get("intent") or "unknown"
 836        project_name = intent_data.get("project_name")
 837        task_description = intent_data.get("task_description")
 838        logger.info("transcribe intent_type=%s project_name=%r", intent_type, project_name)
 839
 840        action_result = None
 841        created = {"project_id": None, "task_id": None}
 842        
 843        # --- HANDLER: CREATE PROJECT ---
 844        if intent_type == "create_project":
 845            new_project_name = project_name
 846            if new_project_name:
 847                created["project_id"] = models.create_project(user.id, new_project_name)
 848                action_result = f"Successfully created project '{new_project_name}'."
 849                logger.info("transcribe created_project_id=%s", created["project_id"])
 850            else:
 851                action_result = "I couldn't determine a project name."
 852        
 853        # --- HANDLER: CREATE TASK ---
 854        elif intent_type == "create_task":
 855            if project_name and task_description:
 856                project = models.get_project_by_name(user.id, project_name)
 857                logger.debug("transcribe project_lookup found=%s", bool(project))
 858                if project:
 859                    models.touch_project(project["id"])
 860                    created["task_id"] = models.create_task(
 861                        project_id=project["id"],
 862                        user_id=user.id,
 863                        description=task_description,
 864                        voice_command=transcript_text,
 865                        raw_transcript=transcript_text,
 866                        intent_type=intent_type,
 867                        intent_confidence=None,
 868                        output_summary=None,
 869                    )
 870                    action_result = f"Created task '{task_description}' in project '{project_name}'."
 871                    logger.info("transcribe created_task_id=%s project_id=%s", created["task_id"], project["id"])
 872                else:
 873                    action_result = f"Could not find a project named '{project_name}'."
 874            else:
 875                action_result = "I couldn't determine the project or task from your command."
 876
 877        # --- HANDLER: STATUS CHECK ---
 878        elif intent_type == "status_check":
 879            projects_with_counts = models.get_user_projects_with_task_counts(user.id)
 880            if not projects_with_counts:
 881                action_result = "You don't have any projects yet. Try saying 'create a project called my-app'."
 882            else:
 883                lines = [f"You have {len(projects_with_counts)} project(s):"]
 884                for p in projects_with_counts:
 885                    total = p["total_tasks"] or 0
 886                    pending = p["pending_tasks"] or 0
 887                    in_prog = p["in_progress_tasks"] or 0
 888                    done = p["completed_tasks"] or 0
 889                    lines.append(f"  '{p['name']}' — {total} task(s) ({pending} pending, {in_prog} in progress, {done} done)")
 890                action_result = "\n".join(lines)
 891            logger.debug("transcribe status_check")
 892
 893        else:
 894            action_result = "I wasn't able to map that command to an action."
 895            logger.debug("transcribe unknown intent")
 896
 897        # Store audit task (skip for create_project — the project IS the artifact)
 898        logged_task_id = None
 899        if intent_type != "create_project":
 900            fresh_projects = models.get_user_projects(user.id)
 901            logged_task_id = models.log_agent_event_task(
 902                user_id=user.id,
 903                project_name=project_name,
 904                projects=fresh_projects,
 905                description=task_description or f"[{intent_type}] {transcript_text}".strip(),
 906                raw_transcript=transcript_text,
 907                intent_type=intent_type,
 908                intent_confidence=None,
 909                output_summary=action_result,
 910                voice_command=transcript_text,
 911            )
 912            logger.info("transcribe logged_task_id=%s user_id=%s", logged_task_id, user.id)
 913
 914        # --- D. DISPATCH TO AGENT PIPELINE (background) ---
 915        dispatch_task_id = created.get("task_id") or logged_task_id
 916        agent_status = None
 917        terminal_granted = get_terminal_access(user.id)
 918        if intent_type in ("create_task", "create_project", "fix_bug") and dispatch_task_id:
 919            if background_tasks:
 920                background_tasks.add_task(agent_dispatch_task, dispatch_task_id, intent_data, terminal_granted)
 921                agent_status = "dispatching"
 922                logger.info("agent dispatch queued task_id=%s terminal=%s", dispatch_task_id, terminal_granted)
 923            else:
 924                # Fallback: run synchronously
 925                try:
 926                    pipeline_result = agent_dispatch_task(dispatch_task_id, intent_data, terminal_granted)
 927                    agent_status = pipeline_result.get("status", "unknown")
 928                except Exception as ae:
 929                    agent_status = f"dispatch_error: {ae}"
 930                    logger.warning("agent dispatch error task_id=%s err=%r", dispatch_task_id, ae)
 931
 932        return {
 933            "status": "success",
 934            "transcript": transcript_text,
 935            "intent": intent_data,
 936            "action_result": action_result,
 937            "context_projects_count": len(user_projects),
 938            "created": created,
 939            "logged_task_id": logged_task_id,
 940            "agent_status": agent_status,
 941            "terminal_access": terminal_granted,
 942        }
 943
 944    except Exception as e:
 945        import traceback
 946        error_trace = traceback.format_exc()
 947        logger.error("transcribe pipeline error=%r", e)
 948        logger.debug("transcribe traceback=%s", error_trace)
 949        return {"status": "error", "message": str(e), "traceback": error_trace}
 950
 951# --- 5b. TEXT COMMAND (dev mode — skips Whisper) ---
 952
 953class TextCommandRequest(BaseModel):
 954    text: str
 955    project_id: str | None = None
 956
 957@app.post("/transcribe-text")
 958@limiter.limit("20/minute")
 959async def transcribe_text(
 960    request: Request,
 961    body: TextCommandRequest,
 962    user: dict = Depends(get_current_user),
 963    background_tasks: BackgroundTasks = None,
 964):
 965    """Same pipeline as /transcribe but accepts text directly (skips Whisper STT)."""
 966    try:
 967        transcript_text = body.text.strip()
 968        if not transcript_text:
 969            return {"status": "error", "message": "Empty text"}
 970
 971        if body.project_id:
 972            state = models.get_conversation_state(user_id=user.id, project_id=request.project_id)
 973            if state and state.get("state") == "awaiting_approval" and state.get("active_command_id"):
 974                fake = ContextualReplyRequest(project_id=body.project_id, reply=transcript_text)
 975                resolved = await resolve_contextual_reply(fake, user)
 976                return {
 977                    "status": "success",
 978                    "transcript": transcript_text,
 979                    "intent": {"intent": "contextual_reply"},
 980                    "action_result": "Resolved pending approval reply.",
 981                    "resolution": resolved,
 982                }
 983
 984        models.upsert_user(
 985            user_id=user.id,
 986            email=getattr(user, "email", None) or f"{user.id}@local",
 987            phone_number=getattr(user, "phone", None),
 988        )
 989
 990        user_projects = models.get_user_projects(user.id)
 991        intent_data = await parse_intent(transcript_text, user_projects) or {"intent": "unknown"}
 992
 993        intent_type = intent_data.get("intent") or "unknown"
 994        project_name = intent_data.get("project_name")
 995        task_description = intent_data.get("task_description")
 996
 997        action_result = None
 998        created = {"project_id": None, "task_id": None}
 999
1000        if intent_type == "create_project":
1001            if project_name:
1002                created["project_id"] = models.create_project(user.id, project_name)
1003                action_result = f"Successfully created project '{project_name}'."
1004            else:
1005                action_result = "I couldn't determine a project name."
1006        elif intent_type == "create_task":
1007            if project_name and task_description:
1008                project = models.get_project_by_name(user.id, project_name)
1009                if project:
1010                    models.touch_project(project["id"])
1011                    created["task_id"] = models.create_task(
1012                        project_id=project["id"], user_id=user.id,
1013                        description=task_description, voice_command=transcript_text,
1014                        raw_transcript=transcript_text, intent_type=intent_type,
1015                    )
1016                    action_result = f"Created task '{task_description}' in project '{project_name}'."
1017                else:
1018                    action_result = f"Could not find a project named '{project_name}'."
1019            else:
1020                action_result = "I couldn't determine the project or task from your command."
1021        elif intent_type == "status_check":
1022            projects_with_counts = models.get_user_projects_with_task_counts(user.id)
1023            if not projects_with_counts:
1024                action_result = "You don't have any projects yet."
1025            else:
1026                lines = [f"You have {len(projects_with_counts)} project(s):"]
1027                for p in projects_with_counts:
1028                    lines.append(f"  '{p['name']}' — {p['total_tasks'] or 0} task(s)")
1029                action_result = "\n".join(lines)
1030        else:
1031            action_result = "I wasn't able to map that command to an action."
1032
1033        # Skip audit log for create_project (the project IS the artifact)
1034        logged_task_id = None
1035        if intent_type != "create_project":
1036            fresh_projects = models.get_user_projects(user.id)
1037            logged_task_id = models.log_agent_event_task(
1038                user_id=user.id, project_name=project_name, projects=fresh_projects,
1039                description=task_description or f"[{intent_type}] {transcript_text}",
1040                raw_transcript=transcript_text, intent_type=intent_type,
1041                intent_confidence=None, output_summary=action_result, voice_command=transcript_text,
1042            )
1043
1044        dispatch_task_id = created.get("task_id") or logged_task_id
1045        agent_status = None
1046        terminal_granted = get_terminal_access(user.id)
1047        if intent_type in ("create_task", "create_project", "fix_bug") and dispatch_task_id:
1048            if background_tasks:
1049                background_tasks.add_task(agent_dispatch_task, dispatch_task_id, intent_data, terminal_granted)
1050                agent_status = "dispatching"
1051
1052        return {
1053            "status": "success",
1054            "transcript": transcript_text,
1055            "intent": intent_data,
1056            "action_result": action_result,
1057            "context_projects_count": len(models.get_user_projects(user.id)),
1058            "created": created,
1059            "logged_task_id": logged_task_id,
1060            "agent_status": agent_status,
1061            "terminal_access": terminal_granted,
1062        }
1063    except Exception as e:
1064        import traceback
1065        logger.error("transcribe-text pipeline error=%r trace=%s", e, traceback.format_exc())
1066        return {"status": "error", "message": "Internal server error"}
1067
1068# --- 5c. TELEGRAM WEBHOOK ---
1069
1070class TelegramWebhookRequest(BaseModel):
1071    update_id: int
1072    message: dict | None = None
1073    edited_message: dict | None = None
1074
1075
1076def _parse_telegram_user_map() -> dict[str, str]:
1077    raw = os.environ.get("TELEGRAM_USER_MAP", "")
1078    if not raw:
1079        return {}
1080    mapping: dict[str, str] = {}
1081    for pair in raw.split(","):
1082        if not pair.strip() or ":" not in pair:
1083            continue
1084        chat_id, user_id = pair.split(":", 1)
1085        mapping[chat_id.strip()] = user_id.strip()
1086    return mapping
1087    
1088@app.post("/api/telegram/webhook")
1089async def telegram_webhook(
1090    request: Request,
1091    background_tasks: BackgroundTasks
1092):
1093    """Receives updates from Telegram bot."""
1094    # Security: check secret token if configured
1095    expected_token = os.environ.get("TELEGRAM_SECRET_TOKEN")
1096    if expected_token:
1097        provided_token = request.headers.get("X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token")
1098        if provided_token != expected_token:
1099            logger.warning("telegram_webhook: unauthorized access attempt (invalid secret token)")
1100            return {"status": "unauthorized"}
1101
1102    try:
1103        data = await request.json()
1104        logger.info("telegram_webhook received payload")
1105        
1106        # Extract message
1107        message = data.get("message") or data.get("edited_message")
1108        if not message:
1109            return {"status": "ignored", "reason": "No message object"}
1110            
1111        chat = message.get("chat", {})
1112        chat_id = chat.get("id")
1113        text = message.get("text", "").strip()
1114        
1115        if not chat_id or not text:
1116            return {"status": "ignored", "reason": "Empty chat_id or text"}
1117
1118
1119        # 1. Authenticate user by chat_id.
1120        telegram_user_map = _parse_telegram_user_map()
1121        created_user = False
1122        user_id = models.get_user_id_by_telegram_chat_id(chat_id)
1123        if not user_id:
1124            user_id = telegram_user_map.get(str(chat_id))
1125            if user_id:
1126                logger.info("telegram_webhook: mapped chat_id=%s to user_id=%s via TELEGRAM_USER_MAP", chat_id, user_id)
1127                if not models.get_user_by_id(user_id):
1128                    models.upsert_user(
1129                        user_id=user_id,
1130                        email=f"{user_id}@local",
1131                        telegram_chat_id=str(chat_id),
1132                    )
1133        if not user_id:
1134            pseudo_user_id = f"tg_{chat_id}"
1135            pseudo_email = f"tg_{chat_id}@telegram.local"
1136            models.upsert_user(
1137                user_id=pseudo_user_id,
1138                email=pseudo_email,
1139                telegram_chat_id=str(chat_id)
1140            )
1141            user_id = pseudo_user_id
1142            created_user = True
1143            await send_telegram_message(
1144                chat_id,
1145                "Welcome to Dispatch! I've created a new account for you. Processing your command now..."
1146            )
1147
1148        '''
1149        # 1. Authenticate user by chat_id
1150        user_id = models.get_user_id_by_telegram_chat_id(chat_id)
1151        if not user_id:
1152            # For this MVP/course project, if we don't recognize the chat_id, we create a new user 
1153            # or ask them to link. Here we auto-provision a pseudo-user for demonstration.
1154            pseudo_user_id = f"tg_{chat_id}"
1155            pseudo_email = f"tg_{chat_id}@telegram.local"
1156            models.upsert_user(
1157                user_id=pseudo_user_id, 
1158                email=pseudo_email, 
1159                telegram_chat_id=str(chat_id)
1160            )
1161            user_id = pseudo_user_id
1162            await send_telegram_message(
1163                chat_id, 
1164                "Welcome to Dispatch! I've created a new account for you. Processing your command now..."
1165            )
1166            # return {"status": "success", "action": "user_created"}
1167        '''
1168            
1169        # 2. Re-use the existing transcribe_text logic for intent parsing
1170        user_projects = models.get_user_projects(user_id)
1171        intent_data = await parse_intent(text, user_projects) or {"intent": "unknown"}
1172        intent_type = intent_data.get("intent") or "unknown"
1173        project_name = intent_data.get("project_name")
1174        task_description = intent_data.get("task_description")
1175
1176        action_result = None
1177        created = {"project_id": None, "task_id": None}
1178
1179        if intent_type == "create_project":
1180            if project_name:
1181                created["project_id"] = models.create_project(user_id, project_name)
1182                action_result = f"Successfully created project '{project_name}'."
1183            else:
1184                action_result = "I couldn't determine a project name."
1185                
1186        elif intent_type == "create_task":
1187            if project_name and task_description:
1188                project = models.get_project_by_name(user_id, project_name)
1189                if project:
1190                    models.touch_project(project["id"])
1191                    created["task_id"] = models.create_task(
1192                        project_id=project["id"], user_id=user_id,
1193                        description=task_description, voice_command=text,
1194                        raw_transcript=text, intent_type=intent_type,
1195                    )
1196                    action_result = f"Created task '{task_description}' in project '{project_name}'."
1197                else:
1198                    action_result = f"Could not find a project named '{project_name}'."
1199            else:
1200                action_result = "I couldn't determine the project or task from your command."
1201                
1202        elif intent_type == "status_check":
1203            projects_with_counts = models.get_user_projects_with_task_counts(user_id)
1204            if not projects_with_counts:
1205                action_result = "You don't have any projects yet."
1206            else:
1207                lines = [f"You have {len(projects_with_counts)} project(s):"]
1208                for p in projects_with_counts:
1209                    lines.append(f"  '{p['name']}' — {p['total_tasks'] or 0} task(s)")
1210                action_result = "\n".join(lines)
1211        else:
1212            action_result = "I wasn't able to map that command to an action."
1213
1214        # Audit/History
1215        logged_task_id = None
1216        if intent_type != "create_project":
1217            fresh_projects = models.get_user_projects(user_id)
1218            try:
1219                logged_task_id = models.log_agent_event_task(
1220                    user_id=user_id, project_name=project_name, projects=fresh_projects,
1221                    description=task_description or f"[{intent_type}] {text}",
1222                    raw_transcript=text, intent_type=intent_type,
1223                    intent_confidence=None, output_summary=action_result, voice_command=text,
1224                )
1225            except Exception:
1226                logger.exception("telegram_webhook: failed to log agent event task user_id=%s", user_id)
1227                logged_task_id = None
1228
1229        # Dispatch Task
1230        dispatch_task_id = created.get("task_id") or logged_task_id
1231        terminal_granted = models.get_terminal_access_for_user(user_id)
1232        if intent_type in ("create_task", "fix_bug") and dispatch_task_id:
1233            background_tasks.add_task(agent_dispatch_task, dispatch_task_id, intent_data, terminal_granted)
1234            
1235        # Send response back to user
1236        if action_result:
1237            await send_telegram_message(chat_id, action_result)
1238
1239        payload = {"status": "success", "processed": True}
1240        if created_user:
1241            payload["action"] = "user_created"
1242        return payload
1243        
1244    except Exception as e:
1245        import traceback
1246        logger.error("telegram_webhook error=%r trace=%s", e, traceback.format_exc())
1247        return {"status": "error"}
1248

1403@app.post("/api/device/claim-next")
1404async def device_claim_next(
1405    request: DeviceClaimRequest,
1406    device: dict = Depends(get_current_device),
1407):
1408    wait_s = max(0, min(request.wait_seconds, 30))
1409    try:
1410        cmd = models.claim_next_queued_command_for_device(device_id=device["id"])
1411    except Exception as exc:
1412        logger.warning("device claim-next error device_id=%s err=%r", device["id"], exc)
1413        cmd = None
1414    if not cmd and wait_s > 0:
1415        deadline = asyncio.get_running_loop().time() + wait_s
1416        while asyncio.get_running_loop().time() < deadline:
1417            await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
1418            try:
1419                cmd = models.claim_next_queued_command_for_device(device_id=device["id"])
1420            except Exception:
1421                cmd = None
1422            if cmd:
1423                break
1424    return {"success": True, "command": cmd}

1476@app.post("/api/unified/commands")
1477async def create_unified_command(
1478    request: UnifiedCommandRequest,
1479    background_tasks: BackgroundTasks,
1480    user: dict = Depends(get_current_user),
1481):
1482    _require_project_owner(user.id, request.project_id)
1483    from agents.command_builder import build_provider_command, normalize_provider
1484
1485    provider = normalize_provider(request.provider or models.get_default_provider_for_user(user.id))
1486    prompt = request.prompt.strip()
1487    if not prompt:
1488        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Prompt cannot be empty")
1489    if request.device_id:
1490        _require_device_owner(user.id, request.device_id)
1491        context = models.get_latest_cursor_context(device_id=request.device_id, project_id=request.project_id)
1492        if context:
1493            file_path = context.get("file_path") or "(unknown file)"
1494            selection = (context.get("selection") or "").strip()
1495            diagnostics = (context.get("diagnostics") or "").strip()
1496            prompt = (
1497                f"{prompt}\n\n"
1498                f"CursorContext file={file_path}\n"
1499                f"Selection:\n{selection or '(none)'}\n"
1500                f"Diagnostics:\n{diagnostics or '(none)'}"
1501            )
1502
1503    session = models.get_or_create_terminal_session_for_project(
1504        user_id=user.id,
1505        project_id=request.project_id,
1506        name=request.session_name or "Unified Session",
1507    )
1508    command = build_provider_command(provider=provider, prompt=prompt)
1509    command_id = models.create_terminal_command(
1510        session_id=session["id"],
1511        user_id=user.id,
1512        command=command,
1513        source=request.source,
1514        provider=provider,
1515        user_prompt=prompt,
1516        normalized_command=command,
1517        status="pending_approval",
1518    )
1519    models.add_conversation_turn(
1520        user_id=user.id,
1521        project_id=request.project_id,
1522        session_id=session["id"],
1523        command_id=command_id,
1524        role="assistant",
1525        turn_type="approval_request",
1526        content=f"Proposed command ({provider}): {command}",
1527    )
1528    models.upsert_conversation_state(
1529        user_id=user.id,
1530        project_id=request.project_id,
1531        state="awaiting_approval",
1532        active_command_id=command_id,
1533        context_json={"provider": provider, "session_id": session["id"]},
1534    )
1535    logger.info(
1536        "unified command pending approval user_id=%s project_id=%s session_id=%s provider=%s source=%s command_id=%s",
1537        user.id,
1538        request.project_id,
1539        session["id"],
1540        provider,
1541        request.source,
1542        command_id,
1543    )
1544    background_tasks.add_task(_background_security_scan, command_id, prompt, command)
1545    return {
1546        "success": True,
1547        "session_id": session["id"],
1548        "command_id": command_id,
1549        "provider": provider,
1550        "normalized_command": command,
1551        "status": "pending_approval",
1552    }
1553

1657@app.post("/api/unified/reply")
1658async def resolve_contextual_reply(
1659    request: ContextualReplyRequest,
1660    user: dict = Depends(get_current_user),
1661):
1662    _require_project_owner(user.id, request.project_id)
1663    reply = (request.reply or "").strip()
1664    if not reply:
1665        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Reply cannot be empty")
1666
1667    state = models.get_conversation_state(user_id=user.id, project_id=request.project_id)
1668    ctx = _load_state_context(state)
1669    active_command_id = request.command_id or (state.get("active_command_id") if state else None)
1670    if not active_command_id:
1671        models.add_conversation_turn(
1672            user_id=user.id,
1673            project_id=request.project_id,
1674            session_id=None,
1675            command_id=None,
1676            role="assistant",
1677            turn_type="info",
1678            content="No pending command to resolve. Submit a command first.",
1679        )
1680        return {"success": True, "intent": "unknown", "message": "No pending command"}
1681
1682    cmd = _require_terminal_command_owner(user.id, active_command_id)
1683    intent = _classify_reply(reply)
1684    models.add_conversation_turn(
1685        user_id=user.id,
1686        project_id=request.project_id,
1687        session_id=cmd.get("session_id"),
1688        command_id=active_command_id,
1689        role="user",
1690        turn_type="reply",
1691        content=reply,
1692    )
1693
1694    if intent == "approve":
1695        risk = (cmd.get("risk_level") or "PENDING").strip().upper()
1696        if risk == "HIGH_RISK":
1697            raise HTTPException(
1698                status_code=403,
1699                detail="High-risk command: confirm with the Approve button in the app (voice approval disabled).",
1700            )
1701        updated = models.update_terminal_command_for_approval(command_id=active_command_id, status="queued")
1702        models.upsert_conversation_state(
1703            user_id=user.id,
1704            project_id=request.project_id,
1705            state="idle",
1706            active_command_id=None,
1707            context_json={},
1708        )
1709        models.add_conversation_turn(
1710            user_id=user.id,
1711            project_id=request.project_id,
1712            session_id=cmd.get("session_id"),
1713            command_id=active_command_id,
1714            role="assistant",
1715            turn_type="approval_result",
1716            content="Approved. Running now.",
1717        )
1718        return {"success": True, "intent": intent, "command": updated}
1719
1720    if intent == "reject":
1721        updated = models.update_terminal_command_for_approval(command_id=active_command_id, status="cancelled")
1722        models.upsert_conversation_state(
1723            user_id=user.id,
1724            project_id=request.project_id,
1725            state="idle",
1726            active_command_id=None,
1727            context_json={},
1728        )
1729        models.add_conversation_turn(
1730            user_id=user.id,
1731            project_id=request.project_id,
1732            session_id=cmd.get("session_id"),
1733            command_id=active_command_id,
1734            role="assistant",
1735            turn_type="approval_result",
1736            content="Rejected. Command will not run.",
1737        )
1738        return {"success": True, "intent": intent, "command": updated}
1739
1740    if intent == "edit":
1741        from agents.command_builder import build_provider_command
1742
1743        provider = (ctx.get("provider") if isinstance(ctx, dict) else None) or cmd.get("provider") or "shell"
1744        edited_command = build_provider_command(provider=provider, prompt=reply)
1745        updated = models.update_terminal_command_for_approval(
1746            command_id=active_command_id,
1747            status="pending_approval",
1748            command=edited_command,
1749            normalized_command=edited_command,
1750        )
1751        models.add_conversation_turn(
1752            user_id=user.id,
1753            project_id=request.project_id,
1754            session_id=cmd.get("session_id"),
1755            command_id=active_command_id,
1756            role="assistant",
1757            turn_type="approval_request",
1758            content=f"Updated proposal: {edited_command}",
1759        )
1760        return {"success": True, "intent": "contextual_reply", "command": updated}
1761
1762    models.add_conversation_turn(
1763        user_id=user.id,
1764        project_id=request.project_id,
1765        session_id=cmd.get("session_id"),
1766        command_id=active_command_id,
1767        role="assistant",
1768        turn_type="question",
1769        content="I can approve, reject, or edit the pending command. Reply with yes/no or an updated command.",
1770    )
1771    return {"success": True, "intent": intent}

1789        # Create (or reuse) project automatically for minimal user friction
1790        inferred_name = (request.project_name or "").strip()

1792            inferred_name = os.path.basename(request.project_path.rstrip("/")) or "Local Project"
1793        project = models.upsert_project_by_name(

1795            name=inferred_name,
1796            file_path=request.project_path,
1797        )
1798        project_id = project["id"]
1799    # else: neither project_id nor project_path provided — register as project-agnostic instance
1800

1804        instance_token=request.instance_token,
1805        pid=request.pid,

1828@app.post("/api/agent/local/claim-next")
1829async def local_agent_claim_next(
1830    request: ClaimNextCommandRequest,
1831    agent_user_id: str = Depends(get_current_agent_user_id),
1832):
1833    """
1834    Local helper pulls the next queued command for sessions bound to its instance.
1835    """
1836    # Basic ownership check
1837    inst = models.get_instance_by_id(request.instance_id)
1838    if not inst:
1839        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Instance not found")
1840    if inst.get("user_id") and inst["user_id"] != agent_user_id:
1841        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden")
1842
1843    wait_s = max(0, min(request.wait_seconds, 30))
1844    cmd = models.claim_next_queued_command_for_user(user_id=agent_user_id)
1845    if not cmd and wait_s > 0:
1846        deadline = asyncio.get_running_loop().time() + wait_s
1847        while asyncio.get_running_loop().time() < deadline:
1848            await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
1849            cmd = models.claim_next_queued_command_for_user(user_id=agent_user_id)
1850            if cmd:
1851                break
1852    return {"success": True, "command": cmd}

1964@app.post("/twilio/incoming")
1965async def twilio_incoming(request: Request):
1966    """
1967    Twilio calls this webhook when someone calls the Twilio number.
1968    It records the caller's voice and sends it to our transcription pipeline.
1969    """
1970    from twilio.twiml.voice_response import VoiceResponse, Record
1971    
1972    response = VoiceResponse()
1973    response.say("Welcome to Dispatch. Please say your command after the beep.")
1974    response.record(
1975        action="/twilio/recording",
1976        method="POST",
1977        max_length=30,
1978        transcribe=False,
1979        play_beep=True,
1980    )
1981    return Response(content=str(response), media_type="application/xml")

1984@app.post("/twilio/recording")
1985async def twilio_recording(request: Request, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks):
1986    """
1987    Twilio calls this after the recording is done.
1988    Downloads the audio, transcribes, parses intent, and dispatches to agent pipeline.
1989    """
1990    import httpx
1991    import tempfile
1992    from twilio.twiml.voice_response import VoiceResponse
1993
1994    form = await request.form()
1995    recording_url = form.get("RecordingUrl")
1996    caller_number = form.get("From", "")
1997
1998    response = VoiceResponse()
1999
2000    if not recording_url:
2001        response.say("Sorry, I could not process your command.")
2002        return Response(content=str(response), media_type="application/xml")
2003
2004    try:
2005        # Download the audio from Twilio
2006        async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
2007            audio_response = await client.get(
2008                f"{recording_url}.mp3",
2009                auth=(os.environ.get("TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID"), os.environ.get("TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN")),
2010            )
2011
2012        # Transcribe via Groq Whisper API
2013        audio_bytes = audio_response.content
2014        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".mp3", delete=True) as tmp:
2015            tmp.write(audio_bytes)
2016            tmp.flush()
2017            transcript = await transcribe_file(tmp.name)
2018
2019        # Look up user by phone number
2020        user_id = models.get_user_id_by_phone(caller_number)
2021        if not user_id:
2022            logger.warning("twilio recording from unknown number=%s", caller_number)
2023            intent_data = await parse_intent(transcript, []) or {"intent": "unknown"}
2024            response.say(f"I heard: {transcript}. But I could not find your account.")
2025            return Response(content=str(response), media_type="application/xml")
2026
2027        # Save call session
2028        call_session_id = models.create_call_session(user_id, caller_number)
2029        user_projects = models.get_user_projects(user_id)
2030        intent_data = await parse_intent(transcript, user_projects) or {"intent": "unknown"}
2031        models.update_call_session(call_session_id, transcript, str(intent_data))
2032
2033        intent_type = intent_data.get("intent", "unknown")
2034        task_description = intent_data.get("task_description") or transcript
2035        project_name = intent_data.get("project_name")
2036
2037        # Create a task from the voice command
2038        logged_task_id = None
2039        if intent_type != "unknown":
2040            logged_task_id = models.log_agent_event_task(
2041                user_id=user_id,
2042                project_name=project_name,
2043                projects=user_projects,
2044                description=task_description,
2045                raw_transcript=transcript,
2046                intent_type=intent_type,
2047                intent_confidence=None,
2048                output_summary=None,
2049                voice_command=transcript,
2050            )
2051
2052        # Dispatch to agent pipeline if actionable
2053        if intent_type in ("create_task", "create_project", "fix_bug") and logged_task_id:
2054            terminal_granted = get_terminal_access(user_id)
2055            background_tasks.add_task(agent_dispatch_task, logged_task_id, intent_data, terminal_granted)
2056            logger.info(
2057                "twilio dispatch queued task_id=%s user=%s terminal=%s",
2058                logged_task_id, user_id, terminal_granted,
2059            )
2060            response.say(f"I heard: {transcript}. Your command is being dispatched now.")
2061        else:
2062            response.say(f"I heard: {transcript}. I've recorded your request.")
2063
2064    except Exception as e:
2065        logger.error("twilio recording error=%r", e)
2066        response.say("Sorry, something went wrong processing your command.")
2067
2068    return Response(content=str(response), media_type="application/xml")

46class AccessLogThrottleFilter(logging.Filter):
47    """
48    Keep useful access logs while suppressing repetitive high-frequency noise.
49    - Drops OPTIONS requests.
50    - Throttles repeated 200 logs for polling endpoints.
51    """
52
53    def __init__(self, window_s: float = 10.0):
54        super().__init__()
55        self.window_s = window_s
56        self._last_seen: dict[str, float] = {}
57        self._lock = threading.Lock()
58        self.noisy_paths = (
59            "/api/device/claim-next",
60            "/api/device/heartbeat",
61            "/api/agent/local/claim-next",
62            "/api/agent/local/heartbeat",
63            "/api/agent/executions/",
64            "/api/terminal/commands/",
65            "/api/terminal/sessions/",
66            "/api/unified/timeline",
67            "/api/terminal/commands/",      # list + logs
68            "/api/terminal/sessions/",      # polling
69            "/api/call-sessions/",          # if it’s chatty
70        )
71
72    def filter(self, record: logging.LogRecord) -> bool:
73        msg = record.getMessage()
74        if "OPTIONS " in msg:
75            return False
76        # If it's one of the noisy endpoints and succeeded, drop it completely
77        if any(p in msg for p in self.noisy_paths) and '" 200 OK' in msg:
78            return False
79
80        # Otherwise, keep the log
81        return True

@app.middleware('http')
async def request_trace_middleware(request, call_next): 
153@app.middleware("http")
154async def request_trace_middleware(request, call_next):
155    request_id = request.headers.get("x-request-id") or str(uuid.uuid4())[:8]
156    request.state.request_id = request_id
157    start = time.perf_counter()
158    try:
159        response = await call_next(request)
160    except Exception:
161        logger.exception("request_id=%s uncaught error path=%s", request_id, request.url.path)
162        raise
163
164    elapsed_ms = int((time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000)
165    # Structured app logs for debugging; keep polling/noisy paths at debug level.
166    is_noisy = (
167        request.url.path.startswith("/api/device/claim-next")
168        or request.url.path.startswith("/api/device/heartbeat")
169        or request.url.path.startswith("/api/device/my-projects")
170        or request.url.path.startswith("/api/device/commands/")
171        or request.url.path.startswith("/api/device/cursor-context")
172        or request.url.path.startswith("/api/agent/local/claim-next")
173        or request.url.path.startswith("/api/agent/local/heartbeat")
174        or request.url.path.startswith("/api/agent/executions/")
175        or request.url.path.startswith("/api/terminal/commands/")
176        or request.url.path.startswith("/api/unified/timeline")
177    )
178    # Avoid spamming INFO for 401 polling failures; still keep errors visible.
179    if is_noisy:
180        level = logging.DEBUG if response.status_code < 500 else logging.WARNING
181    else:
182        level = logging.INFO
183    logger.log(
184        level,
185        "request_id=%s method=%s path=%s status=%s elapsed_ms=%s",
186        request_id,
187        request.method,
188        request.url.path,
189        response.status_code,
190        elapsed_ms,
191    )
192    response.headers["x-request-id"] = request_id
193    return response
def get_current_user( authorization: Annotated[Optional[str], Header(PydanticUndefined)] = None): 
196def get_current_user(authorization: Annotated[Union[str, None], Header()] = None):
197    """
198    Validates the Supabase JWT. Returns the Supabase User object.
199    In DEVELOPMENT_MODE: if a JWT is provided, use it; otherwise fall back to a mock user.
200    """
201    # If a real token is present, always honor it (even in dev mode)
202    has_auth = bool(authorization)
203
204    if has_auth:
205        # If client sent a JWT, we must be able to validate it. Otherwise fail loudly.
206        if not SUPABASE_URL or not SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY:
207            raise HTTPException(
208                status_code=500,
209                detail="Supabase server env not configured (SUPABASE_URL/SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY). Check server/.env loading.",
210            )
211
212        try:
213            if " " in authorization:
214                token = authorization.split(" ")[1]
215            else:
216                token = authorization
217            supabase: Client = create_client(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY)
218            user_response = supabase.auth.get_user(token)
219            u = user_response.user
220            return u
221        except Exception as e:
222            logger.warning("supabase auth failed err=%r", e)
223            raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid or Expired Token")
224
225    # No token (or token invalid in dev): allow mock user only in dev mode
226    if DEVELOPMENT_MODE:
227        class MockUser:
228            id = os.environ.get("DEV_USER_ID", "test-user-123")
229            email = os.environ.get("DEV_USER_EMAIL", "test@example.com")
230            phone = os.environ.get("DEV_USER_PHONE", None)
231        return MockUser()
232
233    raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Missing Authorization Header")

645@app.post("/api/phone/send-otp")

@app.post('/api/device/pair/complete')
async def complete_device_pairing(request: DevicePairCompleteRequest): 
687@app.post("/api/device/pair/complete")
688async def complete_device_pairing(request: DevicePairCompleteRequest):
689    result = models.complete_device_pairing(
690        pairing_code=request.pairing_code,
691        device_name=request.name,
692        platform=request.platform,
693    )
694    if not result:
695        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid or expired pairing code")
696
697    user_id = result["user_id"]
698    device_id = result["device_id"]
699    user_projects = models.get_user_projects(user_id)
700    base_path = models.get_project_base_path_for_user(user_id)
701    for proj in user_projects:
702        local_path = proj.get("file_path") or models.compute_default_project_file_path(base_path, proj.get("name") or "")
703        if local_path:
704            models.link_device_project(device_id=device_id, project_id=proj["id"], local_path=local_path)
705        else:
706            models.link_device_project(device_id=device_id, project_id=proj["id"])
707    logger.info(
708        "device paired device_id=%s user_id=%s auto_linked_projects=%s",
709        device_id, user_id, len(user_projects),
710    )
711    return {"success": True, **result}

761@app.post("/api/device/link-project")
762async def link_project_for_current_device(
763    request: DeviceProjectLinkByNameRequest,
764    device: dict = Depends(get_current_device),
765):
766    """
767    Device-token authenticated endpoint for companion setup:
768    - upserts project by name for the device's user
769    - links that project to this device with local_path
770    """
771    project_name = (request.project_name or "").strip()
772    if not project_name:
773        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="project_name is required")
774    local_path = (request.local_path or "").strip()
775    if not local_path:
776        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="local_path is required")
777
778    project = models.upsert_project_by_name(
779        user_id=device["user_id"],
780        name=project_name,
781        file_path=local_path,
782    )
783    link = models.link_device_project(
784        device_id=device["id"],
785        project_id=project["id"],
786        local_path=local_path,
787    )
788    return {"success": True, "project": project, "link": link}

Device-token authenticated endpoint for companion setup:

  • upserts project by name for the device's user
  • links that project to this device with local_path

797    user: dict = Depends(get_current_user),
798    background_tasks: BackgroundTasks = None,
799):
800    """
801    1. Transcribes Audio (Whisper)
802    2. Fetches Context (SQLite)
803    3. Determines Intent (Bedrock)
804    4. Executes Action (SQLite)
805    5. Dispatches to Agent Pipeline (Background)
806    """
807    try:
808        logger.info("transcribe start user_id=%s filename=%s", getattr(user, "id", None), file.filename)
809
810        # Ensure a corresponding users row exists (id comes from Supabase)
811        models.upsert_user(
812            user_id=user.id,
813            email=getattr(user, "email", None) or f"{user.id}@local",
814            phone_number=getattr(user, "phone", None),
815        )
816
817        # A. Transcribe via Groq Whisper API
818        logger.debug("transcribe step=a")
819        import tempfile as _tempfile
820        with _tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=f"_{file.filename}", delete=True) as tmp:
821            shutil.copyfileobj(file.file, tmp)
822            tmp.flush()
823            transcript_text = await transcribe_file(tmp.name)
824        logger.debug("transcribe text_len=%s", len(transcript_text))
825        
826        # B. Context
827        logger.debug("transcribe step=b")
828        user_projects = models.get_user_projects(user.id)
829        logger.debug("transcribe projects_count=%s", len(user_projects))
830        # C. Parse Intent
831        logger.debug("transcribe step=c")
832        intent_data = await parse_intent(transcript_text, user_projects) or {"intent": "unknown"}
833        logger.debug("transcribe intent=%s", intent_data.get("intent"))
834        
835        # Normalize for storage
836        intent_type = intent_data.get("intent") or "unknown"
837        project_name = intent_data.get("project_name")
838        task_description = intent_data.get("task_description")
839        logger.info("transcribe intent_type=%s project_name=%r", intent_type, project_name)
840
841        action_result = None
842        created = {"project_id": None, "task_id": None}
843        
844        # --- HANDLER: CREATE PROJECT ---
845        if intent_type == "create_project":
846            new_project_name = project_name
847            if new_project_name:
848                created["project_id"] = models.create_project(user.id, new_project_name)
849                action_result = f"Successfully created project '{new_project_name}'."
850                logger.info("transcribe created_project_id=%s", created["project_id"])
851            else:
852                action_result = "I couldn't determine a project name."
853        
854        # --- HANDLER: CREATE TASK ---
855        elif intent_type == "create_task":
856            if project_name and task_description:
857                project = models.get_project_by_name(user.id, project_name)
858                logger.debug("transcribe project_lookup found=%s", bool(project))
859                if project:
860                    models.touch_project(project["id"])
861                    created["task_id"] = models.create_task(
862                        project_id=project["id"],
863                        user_id=user.id,
864                        description=task_description,
865                        voice_command=transcript_text,
866                        raw_transcript=transcript_text,
867                        intent_type=intent_type,
868                        intent_confidence=None,
869                        output_summary=None,
870                    )
871                    action_result = f"Created task '{task_description}' in project '{project_name}'."
872                    logger.info("transcribe created_task_id=%s project_id=%s", created["task_id"], project["id"])
873                else:
874                    action_result = f"Could not find a project named '{project_name}'."
875            else:
876                action_result = "I couldn't determine the project or task from your command."
877
878        # --- HANDLER: STATUS CHECK ---
879        elif intent_type == "status_check":
880            projects_with_counts = models.get_user_projects_with_task_counts(user.id)
881            if not projects_with_counts:
882                action_result = "You don't have any projects yet. Try saying 'create a project called my-app'."
883            else:
884                lines = [f"You have {len(projects_with_counts)} project(s):"]
885                for p in projects_with_counts:
886                    total = p["total_tasks"] or 0
887                    pending = p["pending_tasks"] or 0
888                    in_prog = p["in_progress_tasks"] or 0
889                    done = p["completed_tasks"] or 0
890                    lines.append(f"  '{p['name']}' — {total} task(s) ({pending} pending, {in_prog} in progress, {done} done)")
891                action_result = "\n".join(lines)
892            logger.debug("transcribe status_check")
893
894        else:
895            action_result = "I wasn't able to map that command to an action."
896            logger.debug("transcribe unknown intent")
897
898        # Store audit task (skip for create_project — the project IS the artifact)
899        logged_task_id = None
900        if intent_type != "create_project":
901            fresh_projects = models.get_user_projects(user.id)
902            logged_task_id = models.log_agent_event_task(
903                user_id=user.id,
904                project_name=project_name,
905                projects=fresh_projects,
906                description=task_description or f"[{intent_type}] {transcript_text}".strip(),
907                raw_transcript=transcript_text,
908                intent_type=intent_type,
909                intent_confidence=None,
910                output_summary=action_result,
911                voice_command=transcript_text,
912            )
913            logger.info("transcribe logged_task_id=%s user_id=%s", logged_task_id, user.id)
914
915        # --- D. DISPATCH TO AGENT PIPELINE (background) ---
916        dispatch_task_id = created.get("task_id") or logged_task_id
917        agent_status = None
918        terminal_granted = get_terminal_access(user.id)
919        if intent_type in ("create_task", "create_project", "fix_bug") and dispatch_task_id:
920            if background_tasks:
921                background_tasks.add_task(agent_dispatch_task, dispatch_task_id, intent_data, terminal_granted)
922                agent_status = "dispatching"
923                logger.info("agent dispatch queued task_id=%s terminal=%s", dispatch_task_id, terminal_granted)
924            else:
925                # Fallback: run synchronously
926                try:
927                    pipeline_result = agent_dispatch_task(dispatch_task_id, intent_data, terminal_granted)
928                    agent_status = pipeline_result.get("status", "unknown")
929                except Exception as ae:
930                    agent_status = f"dispatch_error: {ae}"
931                    logger.warning("agent dispatch error task_id=%s err=%r", dispatch_task_id, ae)
932
933        return {
934            "status": "success",
935            "transcript": transcript_text,
936            "intent": intent_data,
937            "action_result": action_result,
938            "context_projects_count": len(user_projects),
939            "created": created,
940            "logged_task_id": logged_task_id,
941            "agent_status": agent_status,
942            "terminal_access": terminal_granted,
943        }
944
945    except Exception as e:
946        import traceback
947        error_trace = traceback.format_exc()
948        logger.error("transcribe pipeline error=%r", e)
949        logger.debug("transcribe traceback=%s", error_trace)
950        return {"status": "error", "message": str(e), "traceback": error_trace}
  1. Transcribes Audio (Whisper)
  2. Fetches Context (SQLite)
  3. Determines Intent (Bedrock)
  4. Executes Action (SQLite)
  5. Dispatches to Agent Pipeline (Background)

@app.post('/api/device/claim-next')
async def device_claim_next( request: DeviceClaimRequest, device: dict = Depends(dependency=<function get_current_device>, use_cache=True, scope=None)): 
1404@app.post("/api/device/claim-next")
1405async def device_claim_next(
1406    request: DeviceClaimRequest,
1407    device: dict = Depends(get_current_device),
1408):
1409    wait_s = max(0, min(request.wait_seconds, 30))
1410    try:
1411        cmd = models.claim_next_queued_command_for_device(device_id=device["id"])
1412    except Exception as exc:
1413        logger.warning("device claim-next error device_id=%s err=%r", device["id"], exc)
1414        cmd = None
1415    if not cmd and wait_s > 0:
1416        deadline = asyncio.get_running_loop().time() + wait_s
1417        while asyncio.get_running_loop().time() < deadline:
1418            await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
1419            try:
1420                cmd = models.claim_next_queued_command_for_device(device_id=device["id"])
1421            except Exception:
1422                cmd = None
1423            if cmd:
1424                break
1425    return {"success": True, "command": cmd}

@app.post('/api/unified/commands')
async def create_unified_command( request: UnifiedCommandRequest, background_tasks: fastapi.background.BackgroundTasks, user: dict = Depends(dependency=<function get_current_user>, use_cache=True, scope=None)): 
1477@app.post("/api/unified/commands")
1478async def create_unified_command(
1479    request: UnifiedCommandRequest,
1480    background_tasks: BackgroundTasks,
1481    user: dict = Depends(get_current_user),
1482):
1483    _require_project_owner(user.id, request.project_id)
1484    from agents.command_builder import build_provider_command, normalize_provider
1485
1486    provider = normalize_provider(request.provider or models.get_default_provider_for_user(user.id))
1487    prompt = request.prompt.strip()
1488    if not prompt:
1489        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Prompt cannot be empty")
1490    if request.device_id:
1491        _require_device_owner(user.id, request.device_id)
1492        context = models.get_latest_cursor_context(device_id=request.device_id, project_id=request.project_id)
1493        if context:
1494            file_path = context.get("file_path") or "(unknown file)"
1495            selection = (context.get("selection") or "").strip()
1496            diagnostics = (context.get("diagnostics") or "").strip()
1497            prompt = (
1498                f"{prompt}\n\n"
1499                f"CursorContext file={file_path}\n"
1500                f"Selection:\n{selection or '(none)'}\n"
1501                f"Diagnostics:\n{diagnostics or '(none)'}"
1502            )
1503
1504    session = models.get_or_create_terminal_session_for_project(
1505        user_id=user.id,
1506        project_id=request.project_id,
1507        name=request.session_name or "Unified Session",
1508    )
1509    command = build_provider_command(provider=provider, prompt=prompt)
1510    command_id = models.create_terminal_command(
1511        session_id=session["id"],
1512        user_id=user.id,
1513        command=command,
1514        source=request.source,
1515        provider=provider,
1516        user_prompt=prompt,
1517        normalized_command=command,
1518        status="pending_approval",
1519    )
1520    models.add_conversation_turn(
1521        user_id=user.id,
1522        project_id=request.project_id,
1523        session_id=session["id"],
1524        command_id=command_id,
1525        role="assistant",
1526        turn_type="approval_request",
1527        content=f"Proposed command ({provider}): {command}",
1528    )
1529    models.upsert_conversation_state(
1530        user_id=user.id,
1531        project_id=request.project_id,
1532        state="awaiting_approval",
1533        active_command_id=command_id,
1534        context_json={"provider": provider, "session_id": session["id"]},
1535    )
1536    logger.info(
1537        "unified command pending approval user_id=%s project_id=%s session_id=%s provider=%s source=%s command_id=%s",
1538        user.id,
1539        request.project_id,
1540        session["id"],
1541        provider,
1542        request.source,
1543        command_id,
1544    )
1545    background_tasks.add_task(_background_security_scan, command_id, prompt, command)
1546    return {
1547        "success": True,
1548        "session_id": session["id"],
1549        "command_id": command_id,
1550        "provider": provider,
1551        "normalized_command": command,
1552        "status": "pending_approval",
1553    }

@app.post('/api/unified/commands/{command_id}/approval')
async def approval_action( command_id: str, request: ApprovalActionRequest, user: dict = Depends(dependency=<function get_current_user>, use_cache=True, scope=None)): 
1580@app.post("/api/unified/commands/{command_id}/approval")
1581async def approval_action(
1582    command_id: str,
1583    request: ApprovalActionRequest,
1584    user: dict = Depends(get_current_user),
1585):
1586    cmd = _require_terminal_command_owner(user.id, command_id)
1587    if cmd.get("status") not in ("pending_approval", "queued"):
1588        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Command is not awaiting approval")
1589    next_status = "queued" if request.action == "approve" else "cancelled"
1590    updated = models.update_terminal_command_for_approval(command_id=command_id, status=next_status)
1591    session = models.get_terminal_session(cmd["session_id"])
1592    project_id = session.get("project_id") if session else None
1593    models.add_conversation_turn(
1594        user_id=user.id,
1595        project_id=project_id,
1596        session_id=cmd.get("session_id"),
1597        command_id=command_id,
1598        role="assistant",
1599        turn_type="approval_result",
1600        content=f"Command {request.action}d.",
1601    )
1602    models.upsert_conversation_state(
1603        user_id=user.id,
1604        project_id=project_id,
1605        state="idle" if next_status != "pending_approval" else "awaiting_approval",
1606        active_command_id=command_id if next_status == "pending_approval" else None,
1607        context_json={},
1608    )
1609    return {"success": True, "command": updated}

1613async def edit_pending_command(

1618):

1622    from agents.command_builder import build_provider_command
1623
