1631        status="pending_approval",
1632        command=new_command,
1633        normalized_command=new_command,
1634        reset_risk_pending=True,
1635    )
1636    session = models.get_terminal_session(cmd["session_id"])
1637    project_id = session.get("project_id") if session else None
1638    models.add_conversation_turn(
1639        user_id=user.id,
1640        project_id=project_id,
1641        session_id=cmd.get("session_id"),
1642        command_id=command_id,
1643        role="assistant",
1644        turn_type="approval_request",
1645        content=f"Edited command ready for approval: {new_command}",
1646    )
1647    models.upsert_conversation_state(
1648        user_id=user.id,
1649        project_id=project_id,
1650        state="awaiting_approval",
1651        active_command_id=command_id,
1652        context_json={"provider": provider, "session_id": cmd.get("session_id")},
1653    )
1654    background_tasks.add_task(_background_security_scan, command_id, new_prompt, new_command)
1655    return {"success": True, "command": updated}
@app.post('/api/unified/reply')
async def resolve_contextual_reply( request: ContextualReplyRequest, user: dict = Depends(dependency=<function get_current_user>, use_cache=True, scope=None)): 
1658@app.post("/api/unified/reply")
1659async def resolve_contextual_reply(
1660    request: ContextualReplyRequest,
1661    user: dict = Depends(get_current_user),
1662):
1663    _require_project_owner(user.id, request.project_id)
1664    reply = (request.reply or "").strip()
1665    if not reply:
1666        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Reply cannot be empty")
1667
1668    state = models.get_conversation_state(user_id=user.id, project_id=request.project_id)
1669    ctx = _load_state_context(state)
1670    active_command_id = request.command_id or (state.get("active_command_id") if state else None)
1671    if not active_command_id:
1672        models.add_conversation_turn(
1673            user_id=user.id,
1674            project_id=request.project_id,
1675            session_id=None,
1676            command_id=None,
1677            role="assistant",
1678            turn_type="info",
1679            content="No pending command to resolve. Submit a command first.",
1680        )
1681        return {"success": True, "intent": "unknown", "message": "No pending command"}
1682
1683    cmd = _require_terminal_command_owner(user.id, active_command_id)
1684    intent = _classify_reply(reply)
1685    models.add_conversation_turn(
1686        user_id=user.id,
1687        project_id=request.project_id,
1688        session_id=cmd.get("session_id"),
1689        command_id=active_command_id,
1690        role="user",
1691        turn_type="reply",
1692        content=reply,
1693    )
1694
1695    if intent == "approve":
1696        risk = (cmd.get("risk_level") or "PENDING").strip().upper()
1697        if risk == "HIGH_RISK":
1698            raise HTTPException(
1699                status_code=403,
1700                detail="High-risk command: confirm with the Approve button in the app (voice approval disabled).",
1701            )
1702        updated = models.update_terminal_command_for_approval(command_id=active_command_id, status="queued")
1703        models.upsert_conversation_state(
1704            user_id=user.id,
1705            project_id=request.project_id,
1706            state="idle",
1707            active_command_id=None,
1708            context_json={},
1709        )
1710        models.add_conversation_turn(
1711            user_id=user.id,
1712            project_id=request.project_id,
1713            session_id=cmd.get("session_id"),
1714            command_id=active_command_id,
1715            role="assistant",
1716            turn_type="approval_result",
1717            content="Approved. Running now.",
1718        )
1719        return {"success": True, "intent": intent, "command": updated}
1720
1721    if intent == "reject":
1722        updated = models.update_terminal_command_for_approval(command_id=active_command_id, status="cancelled")
1723        models.upsert_conversation_state(
1724            user_id=user.id,
1725            project_id=request.project_id,
1726            state="idle",
1727            active_command_id=None,
1728            context_json={},
1729        )
1730        models.add_conversation_turn(
1731            user_id=user.id,
1732            project_id=request.project_id,
1733            session_id=cmd.get("session_id"),
1734            command_id=active_command_id,
1735            role="assistant",
1736            turn_type="approval_result",
1737            content="Rejected. Command will not run.",
1738        )
1739        return {"success": True, "intent": intent, "command": updated}
1740
1741    if intent == "edit":
1742        from agents.command_builder import build_provider_command
1743
1744        provider = (ctx.get("provider") if isinstance(ctx, dict) else None) or cmd.get("provider") or "shell"
1745        edited_command = build_provider_command(provider=provider, prompt=reply)
1746        updated = models.update_terminal_command_for_approval(
1747            command_id=active_command_id,
1748            status="pending_approval",
1749            command=edited_command,
1750            normalized_command=edited_command,
1751        )
1752        models.add_conversation_turn(
1753            user_id=user.id,
1754            project_id=request.project_id,
1755            session_id=cmd.get("session_id"),
1756            command_id=active_command_id,
1757            role="assistant",
1758            turn_type="approval_request",
1759            content=f"Updated proposal: {edited_command}",
1760        )
1761        return {"success": True, "intent": "contextual_reply", "command": updated}
1762
1763    models.add_conversation_turn(
1764        user_id=user.id,
1765        project_id=request.project_id,
1766        session_id=cmd.get("session_id"),
1767        command_id=active_command_id,
1768        role="assistant",
1769        turn_type="question",
1770        content="I can approve, reject, or edit the pending command. Reply with yes/no or an updated command.",
1771    )
1772    return {"success": True, "intent": intent}

1801

1803        user_id=agent_user_id,
1804        project_id=project_id,
1805        instance_token=request.instance_token,
1806        pid=request.pid,
1807        status="online",

1829@app.post("/api/agent/local/claim-next")
1830async def local_agent_claim_next(
1831    request: ClaimNextCommandRequest,
1832    agent_user_id: str = Depends(get_current_agent_user_id),
1833):
1834    """
1835    Local helper pulls the next queued command for sessions bound to its instance.
1836    """
1837    # Basic ownership check
1838    inst = models.get_instance_by_id(request.instance_id)
1839    if not inst:
1840        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Instance not found")
1841    if inst.get("user_id") and inst["user_id"] != agent_user_id:
1842        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden")
1843
1844    wait_s = max(0, min(request.wait_seconds, 30))
1845    cmd = models.claim_next_queued_command_for_user(user_id=agent_user_id)
1846    if not cmd and wait_s > 0:
1847        deadline = asyncio.get_running_loop().time() + wait_s
1848        while asyncio.get_running_loop().time() < deadline:
1849            await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
1850            cmd = models.claim_next_queued_command_for_user(user_id=agent_user_id)
1851            if cmd:
1852                break
1853    return {"success": True, "command": cmd}

@app.post('/twilio/recording')
async def twilio_recording( request: starlette.requests.Request, background_tasks: fastapi.background.BackgroundTasks): 
1985@app.post("/twilio/recording")
1986async def twilio_recording(request: Request, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks):
1987    """
1988    Twilio calls this after the recording is done.
1989    Downloads the audio, transcribes, parses intent, and dispatches to agent pipeline.
1990    """
1991    import httpx
1992    import tempfile
1993    from twilio.twiml.voice_response import VoiceResponse
1994
1995    form = await request.form()
1996    recording_url = form.get("RecordingUrl")
1997    caller_number = form.get("From", "")
1998
1999    response = VoiceResponse()
2000
2001    if not recording_url:
2002        response.say("Sorry, I could not process your command.")
2003        return Response(content=str(response), media_type="application/xml")
2004
2005    try:
2006        # Download the audio from Twilio
2007        async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
2008            audio_response = await client.get(
2009                f"{recording_url}.mp3",
2010                auth=(os.environ.get("TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID"), os.environ.get("TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN")),
2011            )
2012
2013        # Transcribe via Groq Whisper API
2014        audio_bytes = audio_response.content
2015        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".mp3", delete=True) as tmp:
2016            tmp.write(audio_bytes)
2017            tmp.flush()
2018            transcript = await transcribe_file(tmp.name)
2019
2020        # Look up user by phone number
2021        user_id = models.get_user_id_by_phone(caller_number)
2022        if not user_id:
2023            logger.warning("twilio recording from unknown number=%s", caller_number)
2024            intent_data = await parse_intent(transcript, []) or {"intent": "unknown"}
2025            response.say(f"I heard: {transcript}. But I could not find your account.")
2026            return Response(content=str(response), media_type="application/xml")
2027
2028        # Save call session
2029        call_session_id = models.create_call_session(user_id, caller_number)
2030        user_projects = models.get_user_projects(user_id)
2031        intent_data = await parse_intent(transcript, user_projects) or {"intent": "unknown"}
2032        models.update_call_session(call_session_id, transcript, str(intent_data))
2033
2034        intent_type = intent_data.get("intent", "unknown")
2035        task_description = intent_data.get("task_description") or transcript
2036        project_name = intent_data.get("project_name")
2037
2038        # Create a task from the voice command
2039        logged_task_id = None
2040        if intent_type != "unknown":
2041            logged_task_id = models.log_agent_event_task(
2042                user_id=user_id,
2043                project_name=project_name,
2044                projects=user_projects,
2045                description=task_description,
2046                raw_transcript=transcript,
2047                intent_type=intent_type,
2048                intent_confidence=None,
2049                output_summary=None,
2050                voice_command=transcript,
2051            )
2052
2053        # Dispatch to agent pipeline if actionable
2054        if intent_type in ("create_task", "create_project", "fix_bug") and logged_task_id:
2055            terminal_granted = get_terminal_access(user_id)
2056            background_tasks.add_task(agent_dispatch_task, logged_task_id, intent_data, terminal_granted)
2057            logger.info(
2058                "twilio dispatch queued task_id=%s user=%s terminal=%s",
2059                logged_task_id, user_id, terminal_granted,
2060            )
2061            response.say(f"I heard: {transcript}. Your command is being dispatched now.")
2062        else:
2063            response.say(f"I heard: {transcript}. I've recorded your request.")
2064
2065    except Exception as e:
2066        logger.error("twilio recording error=%r", e)
2067        response.say("Sorry, something went wrong processing your command.")
2068
2069    return Response(content=str(response), media_type="application/xml")

Twilio calls this after the recording is done. Downloads the audio, transcribes, parses intent, and dispatches to agent pipeline.
